title: MVP: HIL approval dialog with full decisions + notes + snooze/wait controls
body: Approval dialog offering: Approve; Approve with conditions (notes); Request changes (notes -> agent re-runs); Regenerate; Skip; Reject; Abort pipeline; plus Snooze (defer N min), Wait further (extend), Wait indefinitely. Shows the artifact to review, the reviewer notes/conditions, and the resulting agent re-run. Depends on backend forge:hil-decision-model.
